name: Notes API
requirements:
Build a notes REST API.
- POST /notes with JSON {title, body?} creates a note and returns 201 with {id, title, body, created_at}. title must be 1-200 characters, otherwise 422. body defaults to an empty string.
- GET /notes lists notes in id order. Optional query parameter q filters notes whose title or body contains q, case-insensitively.
- GET /notes/{id} returns one note; PUT /notes/{id} partially updates title/body; DELETE /notes/{id} returns 204.
- Any operation on a note id that does not exist returns 404.
- GET /health returns {"status": "ok"}.

name: Todo API with priorities
requirements:
Build a todo list REST API.
- POST /todos with JSON {title, priority?} creates a todo and returns 201 with {id, title, priority, done}. priority is one of "low", "medium", "high" (default "medium"); any other value returns 422. title must be non-empty. done starts false.
- GET /todos lists todos. Optional query parameter done=true|false filters by completion; optional priority filters by priority.
- PATCH /todos/{id} accepts any of {title, priority, done} and returns the updated todo.
- DELETE /todos/{id} returns 204.
- GET /todos/stats returns {"total": n, "done": n, "open": n}.
- Unknown ids return 404.

name: Inventory API
requirements:
Build an inventory REST API for products.
- POST /products with JSON {sku, name, quantity?, reorder_level?} creates a product and returns 201. sku is unique: creating a duplicate returns 409. quantity and reorder_level are integers >= 0 (default 0 and 5); negative values return 422.
- GET /products/{sku} returns the product; unknown sku returns 404.
- POST /products/{sku}/adjust with JSON {delta} adds delta (may be negative) to quantity and returns the product. If the result would be negative, return 400 and leave quantity unchanged.
- GET /products/low-stock returns products whose quantity is at or below their reorder_level, ordered by sku.
